title: Rook underpromotion: Saavedra finish
queenResult: c8=Q? allows ...Rc4+! and after Qxc4 Black is stalemated.
explanation: Promote to a rook. The rook avoids the stalemate trick and keeps the winning net.

title: Rook underpromotion: mirrored Saavedra finish
queenResult: f8=Q? allows ...Re4+! and after Qxe4 Black is stalemated.
explanation: Promote to a rook. The queen allows the stalemate resource; the rook wins.

title: Bishop underpromotion: queen is stalemate
queenResult: cxb8=Q? is stalemate. Rook promotion also stalemates.
explanation: Capture on b8 and promote to a bishop. Queen and rook are too strong and freeze the black king.

title: Bishop underpromotion: mirrored
queenResult: fxg8=Q? is stalemate. Rook promotion also stalemates.
explanation: Capture on g8 and promote to a bishop. Queen and rook stalemate, bishop keeps the win.

title: Knight underpromotion mate
queenResult: b8=Q? is stalemate. Rook and bishop promotions also stalemate.
explanation: Promote to a knight. The knight gives checkmate; the stronger pieces stalemate.

title: Knight underpromotion mate: mirrored
queenResult: g8=Q? is stalemate. Rook and bishop promotions also stalemate.
explanation: Promote to a knight. The knight gives mate while the queen stalemates.
